logs: confirmation k0 vs hc75-2nd-toriyama (kb-2020 as p2)
confirmation k0 vs mjj-2010-garap-b (kb-2020 as p2)
logRead.note: Only difference: Snorlax Zap Cannon (2020) vs Curse (2022). Zap Cannon is aimed at sensible targets (a predicted Zapdos, paralysing Exeggutor; a super-effective shot at Lapras that missed). Used in 436 of 851 Snorlax games, which win 0.589 vs 0.398 when unused - no sign of misuse. Against the nine panel teams with Miltank (the author's stated reason for Zap Cannon) kb-2022 - kb-2020 = +0.026 [-0.040, +0.097]: no unique advantage.
